name: RI:SE
description: RI:SE is a breakfast television show made by Princess Productions in collaboration with BSkyB for Channel 4 in the United Kingdom. It was scheduled to replace The Big Breakfast after declining ratings. It launched on 29 April 2002. The programme was broadcast between 06:55 and 09:00 in the morning - nationally in the UK.

videos.title: show #1
videos.overview:
This is the first show of channel 4's new breakfast show RI:SE.

During the show Mark had to go to the toliet much to the surprise of Kirsty. RI:SE had there first ""REVIEW"" and most of the critics said there were a few problems but they liked what they saw.

videos.title: show #20
videos.overview: With Big Brother 3 starting tonight, RI:SE have been given exclusive access to all the latest updates and evictee interviews. Older housemates are currently making guest slots on the show.

videos.title: show #48
videos.overview: Marcus and Sarah were interviewed after they broke the World Record of Longest On-Screen Kiss, last night on ""Hollyoaks."" It lasted for over 3 minutes, and they revealed they had to do at least 4 takes.

videos.title: show #51
videos.overview: Rebecca Ritters talks about her new role in Coronation Street, and Big Brother evictee, Adele gets a grilling from the viewers.

videos.title: show #55
videos.overview:
The summary contains spoilers from the film Resident Evil.

Martin Crewes and Milla Jovovich discuss the long-awaited film ""Resident Evil."" Milla, was apparently begged by her younger brother to appear in the film and it's sequel, due out next year, if all goes well. Martin hasn't been invited back, as his character didn't make it through the first film and he will soon fly out to Australia.    The two mentioned that the film is a prequel to the video games, and Jill Valentine will make an appearance in the 2003 sequel. As will Nemesis.

videos.title: show #56
videos.overview: After Spencer was mocked by Liz and Edith for seeming (no more than usual) mute through the first half of the program, he seemed to have opinions on everything for the second half.

videos.title: show #57
videos.overview: With the undecided choice of adopting children, a panda or a puppy the gang decided to leave it upto viewers and let them call in to vote. With all votes counted the puppy won by a mere 3%. Helen didn't seem too impressed by the viewers choice.

videos.title: show #81
videos.overview: RI:SE conducted the first ever quiz on a rollercoaster. Al Convy will be in various theme parks around the UK all week on the world's scariest rollercoasters. He will ask two people 5 questions at the Rollercoasters worst and most terrifying points and whoever gets the most questions correct wins a picture phone, or a holiday.

videos.title: show #84
videos.overview: The stars of ""The Sweetest Thing"" (Cameron, Selma and Christina) dropped by to talk about the new movie, and Selma was sporting a new (cropped) hair-do.

videos.title: show #91
videos.overview: After the rollercoaster quiz, RI:SE are now having their questions take place on a stunt plane. The pilot will ask questions at the most difficult point.. i.e, when the plane is up-side down, or slowly turning on it's side. The person with most questions out of 5 correct wins a Holiday or Picture phone.

videos.title: show #96
videos.overview:
The studio decided to cash in on the success of 'I'm a Celebrity, Get me out of Here' and send correspondent Tom Binns to visit various celebs over the next week and scream at them 'You're a Celebrity.. Let me in There.' Today's celebs were Sam Kane and his wife Linda. When Tom finished rooting through  the cupboards and cringing at their collection of music, he went outside to take a look at their garden.. only to be pushed in the swimming pool by Sam and Linda's 4 year old daughter.... Footage ended there as it was streaming live..

RI:SE also have a new competition called ""Strap me Down""   Viewers get to call in and select a member of Family or close friend they don't trust and have them answer multiple questions..(i.e ""Are you cheating on my partner?"") while hooked upto a Lie Detector. If you want someone to take up the challenge contact the Studio via snail mail;

Strap me Down   RI:SE   Grant Way   Middlesex   Isleworth   TW7 5QD

or via E-mail; strapmedown@risetv.co.uk

videos.title: show #97
videos.overview:
The studio have two new competitions.   The first is an opportunity to win a Nokia picture phone. All you have to do to win the phone is ""Name the Face.""   A certain part of a celebs face (mouth, eyes, nose) will be shown throughout the morning and you have to guess who it is. The studio are giving two phones to each winner and the competition will go on all week.

The other is the chance for a nobody to become a somebody. If you're hopeless at everything RI:SE will train you to sing and dance, send you to all the right places and make you a known face. The winner will also have the opportunity to appear on US chat show ""The Jay Leno Show.""   Auditions are being held tomorrow in;   the Pallasades Shopping Centre   East Mews   Birmingham   B2 4XJ

Further auditions will take place on Friday in Bristol at the Gallery Shopping Centre, 12:00 noon.

videos.title: show #104
videos.overview: Today was the last visit of ""You're a Celebrity.. Let me in There."" Today's celebs were Christine and Neil Hamilton. ""The Cheeky Girls"" Gabriela and Monica of Popstars fame also appeared in the studio and performed an extended version of their infamous song.

videos.title: show #105
videos.overview:
The RI:SE gang have a brand new competition. Following a similar pattern to the Rollercoaster challenge viewers now have the chance to win a holiday to a great European destination, by answering a few simple questions.. while being hurdled down hill in a Yoki Bob.

If you're upto sphereing, zorbing (and most likely barfing?) then call 0207 805 8509 and be ready to travel to one of these locations: Swanage, Ilfracombe, Milton Keyens, Stoke or Swindon. To take up the challenge you must be under 15 stone and physically fit.. unfortunately the task requires over 18's only.

videos.title: show #106
videos.overview:
The RI:SE ""Search for a Nobody"" officially began today. With the studio presenters in charge of picking the talentless nobodies they left it upto viewers to call in and vote for the worst singer of the two. Two new faces will be shown everyday, all week, until Friday's final. The winner will be given a complete transformation, learn how to sing and dance, and the studio will put them in all the right places and make them a known face. The winner will also appear on The Jay Leno Show.

After seeing one of the contestants screeching her way through Whitney's ""i will always love you"" the studio came to the conclusion that she was adding to her performance and the viewers seemed to think the same. Mat Ovens (who wrote his own song & dedicated it to the studio) won the vote with 73% on his side. This granted him a place in Friday's final, but whether he has less talent than the rest of the weeks competitors is yet to be seen.

The Soap Awards also took place last night and 4 stars (two from Brookie, two from Hollyoaks) dropped by to dish the latest gossip. Everyone decided not to sit near Steven Fletcher, who hadn't bothered to wash or have a shave.

Today he went to see ex-Big Brother housemate Tim Culley, who once had his car trashed after leaving the house. Nobody seemed to give a damn though. When the viewers were asked to send in nice e-mails for Tim he only recieved two. He was last seen in September on Loose Women (again, getting booed.)

Today was also the final of ""Search For a Nobody."" Mark (i don't know where he's from, but who cares?) whaled Elvis' classic, Suspisious Minds. He won the competition by 2%

The two later baked a cake (in which she declined to take part) and attempted to give it to one of her neighbours, but nobody was in. Like yesterday, people were asked to send her nice emails. Someone called Dean asked her to paint her toe nails.. she gave a firm ""No"" reply and moved swiftly on.

videos.title: show #119

The studio brought in some Martial Arts experts and in spectacular fashion Liz, Colin and Helen attacked them all in the last minute of the show. Liz and Helen both started off pretty confident mocking the daft noises you here in movies, only to be picked up and thrown on the crash mat. Colin decided this was a great opportunity to climb on Helen, who was uncontrollably laughing.

Colin didn't fair off any better... well he is abit puny isn't he? He lay ""unconcious"" as the credits rolled and Liz was still being thrown in the air. It had to be one of the funniest moments to date, on RI:SE.   (Duds didn't take part.)

videos.overview:
RI:SE have a brand new challenge. ""Iron guts"" is pretty much a self-explanatory title. All you have to do is eat as much foul tasting food as you can handle. If you have Iron guts then call 020 7805 8530. The competition takes place in London.. no details yet on what the prizes are.

Also, if you live anywhere near ""Beach"" nightclub in Sunderland, go down over the weekend and check out Mark Scott perform his new single.

Ed Sanders, the new reporter, also hosted Iron guts. The competitors had to either eat (actually, they had to scoff) either Ed's left over Curry or some Apple Pie. Being the generous viewers we all are, the two were forced to eat Ed's curry.. then be spun around in a Theme Park ride after eating 20 pickled onions (on top of the curry.) All before 7:30am. Once a caller gets the link correct they win 100, but they can gamble for 500. The caller choses one of the three faces on the fruit machine and to win 500 there has to be one photo matching the celebrity the caller chose. If two matching pictures come up they can gamble their 500 for the full 2k. To win it all the money, all three pictures on the machine have to match. If they don't, the caller gets their original prize money.
